# Kanerika

> > Kanerika is an enterprise technology consulting firm specializing in AI integration, digital transformation, and intelligent automation solutions across manufacturing and business operations.

Kanerika provides expertise in emerging AI frameworks like Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration, Superagency workflows, and digital transformation strategies. The company focuses on helping enterprises leverage technologies including IoT, robotics, data analytics, and AI agents to modernize operations and optimize business processes.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Integration
- Superagency AI Workflows
- Digital Transformation
- Manufacturing Automation
- AI Agent Frameworks
- Microsoft Fabric
- Intelligent Automation
- IoT and Robotics
- Data Analytics
- Context Management
- Workplace Transformation
- Enterprise AI Integration
- Digital Twins
